note: Idiom manifest for dynamic/indirect calls in Python -- keyed by callee-expression shape. Reflective dispatch (getattr/eval) is an acknowledged blind spot but is marked 'unresolved' and counted, not dropped. Method calls on a known receiver are resolvable-by-idiom.

reflective.shape: Call-callee whose func is a reflective builtin
reflective.describe: getattr(o, name)() / eval(...)() -- the target depends on runtime data. Known blind spot; mark unresolved.

computed_member.describe: table[key](...) / handlers[name](...) -- dispatch through a dict/list of callables. Conservatively resolvable to the callables stored in that container; unresolved without the binding.

method_dispatch.describe: recv.method(...) -- resolvable to the method when the receiver type is known (idiom), else a member the engine still sees.
